source_evidence: Most brokers are compensated through a markup over the cost of the bond to the firm. This markup might be disclosed on your confirmation statement. If a commission is charged, it will be reported on your confirmation statement.
question: Misconception: A broker’s compensation for a municipal bond purchase will always appear as a separate commission on the confirmation statement.
answer: A broker may instead be compensated through a markup over the firm’s cost of the bond. A markup might be disclosed on the confirmation statement, while a commission, if charged, will be reported there. Ask your broker about markups and commissions.
